set.body: Resolve interim audit findings 1-8 before effectagram freezes its 0.1 API. The epic establishes explicit experimental and neural feature identity, component-aware execution, budget-driven planning, scoped source access, observational receipts, a narrow neuroim2 adapter, and a supported-only public API. Completion requires semantic, resource, installed-artifact, documentation, and package certification gates; passing unit tests alone is insufficient.
set.title: Harden effectagram 0.1 contracts and execution before API freeze
